result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations with partial derivatives in variables r, s (and p, q with s=p+q, r=p−q) of functions α, γ, a, b, c, β, apparently composing second-order differential operators in connection with the heat-conduction prize problem.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^5\alpha}{\partial s\partial r^4}+\frac{\partial^4\alpha}{\partial s^2\partial r^2}+\frac{\partial^3\alpha}{\partial s^3}-2\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial s\partial r}\frac{\partial^3\alpha}{\partial r^3}-4\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial s\partial r^2}$
$\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial r^2}+\frac{\partial\gamma}{\partial s}+\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial r^2}\gamma=0$
$\partial_r^2+\partial_s^2+2\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\partial_r+b=\partial_s+$ $\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}=2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}$
$\partial_s+\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\partial_r+c$
$+2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial r\partial s}\partial_r^2-2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial r\partial s}\partial_r^2$
$+2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial r^2}\partial_r\partial_s-2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}\partial_r\partial_s$
$+2\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial r\partial s^2}\partial_r+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s}\partial_r-\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial r^2\partial s}\partial_r-\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial s^3}\partial_r+\left(2\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}-2\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s\partial r}\right)\partial_r-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}\partial_r$
$+\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}\partial_s$ [-...-] $-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}\partial_s$
$+\frac{\partial^2 b}{\partial r\partial s}+\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\frac{\partial b}{\partial r}-\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}-\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s^2}-2\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}$
$+\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s^2}-\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}+2\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}-2\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}+2c\left(\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial r^2}\right)=0$
$\frac{\partial c}{\partial p}=\frac{\partial c}{\partial s}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial r}$ $s=p+q$
$\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial p\partial q}=\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s^2}-\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial r^2}$ $r=p-q$
$c=\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s\partial r}$ $b=2\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s^2}$
$-\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial r^2\partial s}-\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial s^3}+2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial s}-2\frac{\partial a}{\partial r}\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial s\partial r}=2\partial_s\left(\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial r^2}-\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial s^2}\right)$

$\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial p\partial q}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial p}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}+2c\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial p\partial q}=0$ $\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial p\partial q}=-\beta$
[-$\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}=\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial p\partial q}$ $-\beta\frac{\partial a}{\partial q^2}$-]$+$ $\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\beta\left(\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\right)^2-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial q^2}\right)=\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial c}{\partial q}3\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial p\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+2c\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial p\partial q^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}$
$-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}$ $-2\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial p\partial q}\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial q^2}$
$\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\beta\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\right)^2-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial q^2}\right)}{\partial p}+\frac{\partial\beta}{\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\right)^2+\beta\left(3\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial p\partial q}\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\right)^2-\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}\right)+2\beta\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial p\partial q}\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial q^2}-\frac{\partial^3 a}{\partial p\partial q^2}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\right)$
$=\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial q^2}\frac{\partial^2 a}{\partial p^2}\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}\right)^2+\partial^2 a$
